data.name: Tutankhamun – Builders of the Eternal
data.detailed_description:
Step into the golden age of ancient Egypt and create thriving cities along the Nile. Inspired by the golden age of classic city-builders, Tutankhamun: Builders of the Eternal brings back the timeless charm of strategic planning, resource management, and vibrant urban life—with a modern 3D touch.

  • Plan and Expand: Lay roads, zone houses, and manage immigration to grow your city from a small village into a bustling metropolis.

  • Provide for Your People: Supply water, food, and entertainment to keep citizens healthy and loyal.

  • Balance the Economy: Collect taxes, manage trade, and keep your treasury afloat while meeting the demands of Pharaoh.

  • Face Ancient Challenges: Prepare for fire, collapse, and other disasters that will test your leadership.

  • Immersive Presentation: Lush 3D environments, dynamic overlays, and atmospheric sound bring the Nile valley to life like never before.

Built for fans of historical city builders, Tutankhamun: Builders of the Eternal brings strategic planning, resource management, and vibrant urban life into a modern 3D ancient Egyptian setting.

Battle Fire and Urban Hazards

Keep your city safe from sudden disasters that threaten its survival.

  • Fires spread quickly through tightly packed districts unless properly managed

  • Firewatch posts dispatch walkers to patrol neighborhoods and prevent flare-ups

  • Building wear, collapse risks, and maintenance needs keep your planning sharp

  • A well-organized layout can stop disasters before they overwhelm your city

  • Visual fire effects bring danger to life as flames ignite rooftops and structures

Farm the Nile

Cultivate fertile floodplains, manage irrigation, and produce the food your people need to prosper.

  • Establish farms along the rich soil of the Nile.

  • Grow crops that depend on water access and land fertility.

  • Manage seasonal production cycles tied to the river.

  • Store and distribute harvests efficiently to avoid shortages.

  • Watch farmers plow, plant, and deliver goods across your city.

Raise an Army

Train soldiers, maintain order, and protect your city from emerging threats.

  • Recruit and train units from dedicated military buildings.

  • Manage weapon production, supplies, and troop morale.

  • Patrol your borders to keep citizens safe.

  • Respond quickly to crises and external challenges.

  • Use military presence to stabilize vulnerable districts.

Build Monuments

Construct sacred sites and monumental structures that define your legacy.

  • Lay foundations for temples, shrines, and ceremonial complexes.

  • Manage massive workforce demands across long construction phases.

  • Produce and transport materials through coordinated supply chains.

  • Watch monuments visually rise step-by-step as laborers work.

  • Earn prestige, bonuses, and cultural influence from completed wonders.

Honor the Gods

Appease powerful deities who watch over every aspect of life along the Nile.

  • Build temples, shrines, and festivals dedicated to specific gods.

  • Receive blessings that improve harvests, fertility, or city morale.

  • Avoid curses by maintaining regular worship and offerings.

  • Organize priestly processions that bring your city to life.

  • Shape city identity based on which gods you choose to honor.

Engage in Trade

Connect with neighboring regions to secure resources and wealth for your city.

  • Open trade routes with cities up and down the Nile.

  • Import scarce goods and export your surplus to grow the treasury.

  • Manage warehouses, depots, and delivery logistics.

  • Balance supply chains to ensure food, materials, and luxury goods reach citizens.

  • Watch traders arrive by riverboats and caravans, bringing the world to your doorstep.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (21H2 or newer)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 (6 cores)
  • Memory: 16  GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
